page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
liked_song_ids = set()
all_pages = []
while True:
    res = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('LIKED_PAGE', page_index, 'LEN', len(res))
    if not res:
        break
    all_pages.append(res)
    for s in res:
        liked_song_ids.add(s['song_id'])
    page_index += 1

print('TOTAL_LIKED_SONGS', len(liked_song_ids))
print('LIKED_SONG_IDS_SAMPLE', sorted(list(liked_song_ids))[:20])

print('<playbook_cite>Following entry [Problem Solving Heuristics: stateful queues]: bound subset by queue position <= current song; then like each track.</playbook_cite>')
print('<uncertainty>Interpreting “played so far” as all queue items with position <= current item position.</uncertainty>')

# build played-so-far subset from the previously fetched queue
played_so_far = [s for s in queue if s['position'] <= max(x['position'] for x in queue if x.get('is_current'))]
played_song_ids = [s['song_id'] for s in played_so_far]
print('PLAYED_SO_FAR_COUNT', len(played_so_far))
print('PLAYED_SO_FAR_IDS', played_song_ids)

# Filter out ones already liked
already_liked = [sid for sid in played_song_ids if sid in liked_song_ids]
to_like = [sid for sid in played_song_ids if sid not in liked_song_ids]
print('ALREADY_LIKED', already_liked)
print('TO_LIKE', to_like)

results = []
for sid in to_like:
    res = apis.spotify.like_song(song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    print('LIKE_SONG', sid, 'RES', res)
    results.append((sid, res))
print('DONE_LIKES', len(results))
